headline: Apple to limit daily Siri AI use, tied to iCloud+ plan
summary: Apple is testing daily usage limits for more complex Siri AI and Apple Intelligence interactions in iOS, iPadOS and macOS 27.3 betas. Basic Siri commands will remain free and unlimited, but advanced, server-side features will be capped, with how much a user can use tied to their iCloud+ plan.
